name: aif-ext-memlab
description: Project memory for AI Factory via memlab: registers the memlab MCP server and lets /aif-warmup, /aif-explore, /aif-plan and /aif-fix ask it for past decisions and the code a change touches. Optional by construction: without memlab every skill behaves as before.

commands.name: memlab-plugin
commands.description: Claude Code: install the memlab plugin and drop the duplicate .mcp.json entry

mcpServers.instruction: memlab: install it first — pip install git+https://github.com/sattva2020/memlab (Python 3.11+). Claude Code: run `ai-factory memlab-plugin` to switch to the memlab plugin (hooks + /memlab:* commands) and drop this entry, so only one memlab server starts.
